meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会开启“对抗式多代理规划”:先提示已启动,再派出 5 个互相挑刺的评审角色对计划交叉批判,只保留没被推翻的洞见,并强制交给 plan 代理做成可执行方案。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词,或明确要求对抗式/交叉批判式规划时触发。也适用于需要最高严格度、想暴露弱假设、盲点与过度设计的规划场景。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 制定一个发布计划,列出所有薄弱假设。
say.note: 会启动 5 名评审互批,再产出计划。

say.text: hpp: 对这个方案做交叉批判式规划。
帮我 /hyperplan 一个重构计划,专挑过度设计。
say.note: skeptic 会重点攻击过度工程。

howto.what_en: Claude launches adversarial multi-agent planning: announces start, spawns 5 hostile reviewers who attack each other's findings, keeps only surviving insights, then hands them to the plan agent for executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', etc., or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning. Also for planning needing maximum rigor, exposing weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to draft a release plan and list all weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-reviewer cross-critique and produces the plan.

say_en.text: hpp: run cross-critique planning on this proposal.
Help me /hyperplan a refactor plan, specifically hunt over-engineering.
say_en.note: The skeptic member will attack over-engineering.
